children.text: There are several different ways to start the quest chain:
Buying the poster on the Flea Market
One of the easiest options is to purchase the required poster from the Flea Market, which immediately activates the start of the chain.
Finding the poster in raids
The poster can also be found manually during raids. The currently known spawn locations are:
Customs
— the three-story dormitory;
Ground Zero
— the starter tutorial corridor or a wall outside;
Lighthouse
— the depot at the Rogue base, as well as the upper chalet: the poster is located on the cab of the Gazelle van opposite the entrance.
Message from “The Station”

After logging into the game, you may receive a message from “The Station.” Simply reading it will automatically begin the quest chain. This becomes available after unlocking Intelligence Center Level 3.
Dialogue with Mr. Kerman

If you complete the “Savior” ending and choose to cooperate with Kerman, during the quest involving the transfer of compromising TerraGroup documents you can ask him about possible leads. In response, Kerman will mention the acquisition of a marine contractor and direct you to Mechanic. This starts the “Borey” storyline.

children.text: Next, you need to find transportation to the Icebreaker. To do this, you must arrange passage with the BTR Driver and extraction from the Icebreaker with Prapor.
Depending on your choices in the
Falling Skies
storyline, Prapor may offer three different options:
Quest case: “Ticket Not Found”
— he will send you to kill 30 Scavs on Reserve and launch a flare near the transition to Woods (behind the depot).
Quest case: “Ticket Handed Over to Prapor”
— he will immediately send you to find AMG-10 aviation oil (see below).
Quest case: “Ticket Kept for Yourself”
— he will ask you to hand over 3
Military Filters
marked “Found in Raid.”
Then Prapor sends you to the Reserve location to search for AMG-10 aviation oil. Possible spawn locations:
Helicopter in the courtyard: inside or nearby next to the forklift;
School building (“Black Bishop”) in the basements.

children.text: Next, go to the BTR Driver, who is supposed to help arrange transportation to the Icebreaker.
Depending on the completion of his questline and the decisions made during it, there are three possible outcomes:
Questline completed with the good ending
— the Driver helps you for free. He tells you about smugglers at the pier on Shoreline who are willing to transport you to the Icebreaker for 400k roubles.
Questline completed with the bad ending (Skier route)
— you must bring the Driver 200 rounds of
7.62x54mm R BT gzh
ammunition (Found in Raid status not required). Then you need to locate Skier’s documents on Customs and burn them in any barrel.
Find Skier’s documents on Customs map
. After that, you must kill 15 targets of any kind in smuggler camps on Interchange or Shoreline.
Driver questline NOT completed
— he asks you to kill 10 targets of any kind in smuggler camps on Interchange or Shoreline.
Find the smuggler camp on Shoreline.

value.title: The smugglers camp on the Shoreline

children.text: Find the smuggler camp on Interchange.
After completing the tasks from both the BTR Driver and Prapor, you gain access to the Icebreaker. To enter, you need:
400,000 roubles
for entry (departure from Shoreline at Norvinsky Port via boat);
2,500 euros
and a
green RSP flare
for extraction from the location by helicopter.
Find the boat to the Icebreaker on Shoreline.
Icebreaker Walkthrough
For your convenience, the guide is also available on the Icebreaker map.
Preparing for the Raid

Before entering the raid, it's highly recommended to bring your best gear. On Icebreaker, you'll face heavily equipped enemies, so don't skimp on armor, meds, or ammunition. Bringing some provisions is also useful, along with a flashlight or night vision device, as certain sections of the ship are very poorly lit. Don't forget
for the helicopter extraction and a
Green RSP flare
(if you forget it, you can pick one up near the start of the location).
Weapons chambered in
are strongly recommended. Black Division operatives frequently use the
M4A1
and its variants, allowing you to replenish ammunition during the raid by looting magazines from fallen enemies.
First Steps Aboard the Ship
You have
40 minutes
to complete the raid.
Icebreaker consists of multiple decks connected by compartments and corridors, so progression largely revolves around opening doors and clearing rooms.
You spawn on the nighttime version of the location. Near the starting area, you can find a green
RSP-30 signal flare
, as well as various tools and consumables. Advance carefully. You'll encounter both
Renegades
and
Black Division
units. These are extremely dangerous enemies equipped with top-tier armor, large health pools, and powerful weapons.
Finding the Keycard
After the raid begins, move along the left side of the deck and open the blast door. Proceed through the next door, where you'll encounter enemies, including
Knight
and several Renegades. Continue through the corridors until you reach the
Infirmary
. Inside one of the rooms, you'll find the body of an engineer. Search it and take the keycard required for further progression.
Find keycard on Icebreaker map
. Clear nearby compartments of Renegades to make navigation through the ship significantly easier later on.

slider.caption: Meeting Point with the Renegades and Knight

children.text: Contacting the Crew
Return to the main corridor and locate the intercom.
Find Intercom on Icebreaker map.
Use it to contact a surviving crew member and receive a quest update.
Keep in mind that this dialogue can only be triggered once. Even if you die afterward, this step will remain completed.
Lower Decks and the Arrival of Black Division

With the access card in hand, head down to the lower decks and find the door with a keypad. Use the keycard to unlock it. Upon entering, a cutscene will play, showing Black Division forces arriving aboard Icebreaker.
Continue through the corridors until you reach the
Engine Room
Find way to Engine Room on the Icebreaker map.

Once you move into the central section, the first major enemy wave will appear. Expect roughly six Black Division operatives. Fight carefully using cover, peek corners whenever possible, make active use of grenades, and catch enemies while they're repositioning.
After clearing the area, be sure to loot the bodies. These enemies often carry unique equipment, gas masks, and other valuable items.
Reaching the Helipad
After securing the Engine Room, make your way to the upper levels of the ship.
Find stairs to roof on Icebreaker map.

value.title: Stairs to the roof of the engine room

children.text: When you reach the helipad, be prepared for another Black Division squad positioned behind containers and crates.
Eliminate all hostiles before stepping onto the open platform.
This is one of the extraction points. To activate it, fire a
Green RSP flare
from the center of the helipad. Approximately
40 seconds later
, a helicopter will arrive.
If any enemies remain nearby, they may attack you while waiting for extraction.
Important:
Do
NOT
shoot the helicopter after it arrives, or the extraction will be canceled.
Continuing the Storyline
If you want to progress the story, do not leave immediately.

From the helipad, descend to the lower decks and move toward the bow of the ship. Along the way, you'll encounter additional Black Division patrols that must be eliminated. Circle around the front of the ship and reach the opposite side of the deck. More enemies may be present there.

points.title: The way to the door with a chain, we go around the bow of the ship
The way to the door with a chain, climb the stairs to the door
The way to the door with a chain, we go down the stairs to the bow of the ship

fields.linkText: Find the way to the chain door on Icebreaker map.

children.text: Continue until you find a door wrapped in chains. This is your objective. Opening it requires an explosive charge (covered later). Interacting with the door will update the quest.
Finishing the Raid
Once all required actions are completed, return to the helipad and call in extraction using the green flare.
After successfully extracting, speak with
Mechanic
. This unlocks the next stage of the storyline involving the explosives and the events aboard Icebreaker. Mechanic will recommend speaking with
Prapor
, after which the
Explosive Charge SZ-1
becomes available for purchase for
(it can be placed in a Special Slot).
This also unlocks a questline from the
BTR Driver
, which eventually grants direct access to Icebreaker from the Hideout deployment screen. Begin this questline with
Stick To It
and continue through the subsequent quests as they become available.
Breaching the Sealed Compartment
Before your next trip to Icebreaker, bring an explosive charge and a gas mask.
The best option is a Black Division gas mask looted from operatives, but any model that provides gas protection will work.
Once you reach the chained door, plant the charge and move to a safe distance. After the explosion, open the inner door, but don't rush inside.
Find the chain door on Icebreaker map.

value.title: The way to the door with a chain, climb the stairs to the door

children.text: Immediately beyond the doorway is a gas trap. You can either manually disable it or simply survive the exposure while wearing a gas mask. This marks the beginning of one of the most dangerous sections of Icebreaker.
Encountering The Wedge
Ahead lies
The Wedge
, an elite unit even more dangerous than standard Black Division operatives.
These enemies possess lightning-fast aim, exceptional accuracy, and top-tier armor-piercing ammunition. A single mistake can result in instant death.
The boss usually spawns with
3–6 guards
. They most commonly occupy the long corridor and the gymnasium on the right side. They frequently throw flashbangs, so stay alert.
Before entering the corridor, it's recommended to throw a grenade immediately, as the boss may already be positioned there.
At the time of writing, the most effective strategy is to engage the boss and guards through multiple smoke grenades. Make sure to set
Volumetric Lighting
to
Ultra

in the graphics settings, otherwise visibility inside smoke will be extremely poor. Use the smoke to bait enemies into pushing your position and eliminate them as they advance. There's a good chance this tactic will be adjusted in future patches, but it currently works well.
If you're lucky, you can also fire an
RShG
down the corridor and potentially one-shot the boss and his entourage.
After eliminating the group, thoroughly search the area. Their bodies can contain various keycards and rare items required for future quests and valuable loot.
Finding the Gas Cutter and CQ keycard
While on this floor, make sure to visit the kitchen. A
gas cutter
can be found there, and you'll need it much later to access one of the story routes. If you miss it now, you'll have to return to Icebreaker later. A
CQ Crew Keycard
can also spawn in the same area.

children.text: Ascending to the Upper Levels
Continue upward through the ship. To progress further, you must climb two decks above the boss area.
Along the way you'll encounter:
Keypad-locked doors
Keycard-restricted rooms
Locked technical compartments
Codes for most doors can be found on nearby boards. These are usually random four-digit combinations.
Inside, you'll often find valuable loot and rare electronics.
Find board with code on Icebreaker map.

value.title: Board on the wall with random code

children.text: On the fourth tier, you can locate an office containing documents. Access requires either a
Crew Keycard
or a
C-1 Keycard
. These documents may be useful for future story quests, making them worth collecting in advance.
The Keypad Door
Continue ascending toward the upper decks.
In one compartment you'll find a sealed door leading outside. Exit through it, climb the exterior staircase, and open the white door at the top.
Inside is a keypad-locked door.
Find the door with keypad on Icebreaker map.
Visiting it for the first time updates the storyline, but not everyone will be able to open it immediately.
To obtain the code naturally through the questline:
Return to the Scientist and obtain the first part of the combination.
Speak with Mechanic to receive the second part. He'll send you to plant device on The Labs, if you didn't do it during Blue Fire quest.
Find place of planting the device on The Labs map
If you've already completed those quests, the full code will be available immediately.
Alternatively, you can enter the static code directly:
The Captain's Bridge
After opening the door, continue through the corridor.
Roughly six Black Division operatives can spawn in the rooms ahead. Clear them and proceed toward the captain's area.
This section contains a large amount of valuable loot, including new electronic items needed later:
Ultralink
Memento
Gigachad

These items are required for future data decryption. Exit outside and climb the stairways to the top until you reach the bridge. At the top you'll see a hatch that must be opened using the gas cutter found earlier. Cut it open and jump inside.
Find the hatch on Icebreaker map.

value.title: Lock on the captain's roof, opened by a gas burner

children.text: Inside the bridge you'll find the captain's body. Nearby lies the
C-1 High-Level Access Keycard
. Make sure to take it.
Find C-1 Keycard on Icebreaker map.

slider.caption: Roof Hatch Opened with a Gas Torch

children.text: Speaking with the Scientist
After obtaining the captain's keycard, contact the Scientist through the intercom.
Find Intercom on Icebreaker map.
Inform him about the death of the crew and the captain. You'll learn that the Scientist is ready to leave the ship, but ordinary extraction isn't acceptable to him.
To arrange evacuation, you'll need to work with the
BTR Driver
Server Room and Archive Drives
For the next stage, return to Icebreaker's upper levels.
Near the central staircase is the server section. The door requires the
C-1 Keycard
. Inside, locate
three archive drives

. Their locations are marked by the quest, making them difficult to miss. Valuable loot also spawns here. Also there's a quest document on the wall next to the server room, don't forget to pick it up.

points.title: Server room opened by C-1 card
Document on the wall near the server room

fields.linkText: Find server room and documents on Icebreaker map.

children.text: After collecting all drives, return to the Hideout and hand them over to Mechanic for decryption.

slider.caption: Server Room with Drives and Quest Loot

children.text: Preparing the Scientist's Evacuation
After speaking with the BTR Driver, you'll discover that additional equipment is required for a safe evacuation.
You must provide:
5 respirators or gas masks
A
Kirasa-N
body armor
Two Class 5 (or higher) armor plates compatible with the Kirasa-N
You must also eliminate
20 enemies
on Icebreaker.
Once all requirements are met, speak with the BTR Driver again for further instructions.
The Code Phrase
Your next objective is to inform the Scientist about the upcoming evacuation. Return to Icebreaker, contact him through the intercom, and relay the code phrase provided by the BTR Driver.
Find Intercom on Icebreaker map.
Afterward, report back. In return, the BTR Driver will provide a
single-use C-3 Keycard
Final Visit to the Scientist's Shelter
Before the next raid, bring a
Audio recorder
. Reach the Scientist's laboratory, use the C-3 card on the intercom, and enter. The Scientist will already be gone.
Inside you'll find:
A story-related audio cassette (
find the cassette on the map
Large quantities of medical supplies
Rare medical items (four
LEDX
units can spawn on one of the tables)
Valuable loot in adjacent rooms
Since the C-3 Keycard is single-use, loot everything thoroughly. It's highly recommended to listen to the cassette immediately, as it contains important information about Icebreaker's story.
Decrypting the Archives
To fully process the archive drives, Mechanic requires additional hardware.
You'll need:
Ultralink
Satellite Communication Modules
Memento
Server Memory Modules
Gigachad
Cryptographic Processors
Most of these items are found exclusively on Icebreaker, usually behind locked doors and inside electronics-rich areas. Turn them in to Mechanic as you find them.
Once the decryption process is complete, he'll send the resulting files through in-game mail.
Story Finale
After receiving Mechanic's message, open the archive data and carefully study the documents. Reading the files completes the Icebreaker storyline and awards the achievement:
"Cracks in the Ice"
